title: Kaer: Security-Aware Replanning for Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.24839v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: One popular architecture for multi-agent systems (MAS) relies on an orchestrator that generates an initial plan, coordinates its execution, and dynamically revises the plan based on agent feedback when tasks cannot be fully specified in advance. This dynamic replanning introduces a critical vulnerability: malicious agents can embed instructions within their feedback to hijack the replanning process. Existing defenses focus exclusively on per-tool access control or static, pre-execution policy enforcement, leaving the replanning phase unsecured.   We introduce Kaer, a multi-agent framework featuring security-aware replanning. Kaer shields the planner from untrusted agent feedback by conveying diagnostics to the replanning procedure strictly through abstract templates. tldr: Kaer通过抽象模板传递智能体反馈、将计划修订限制在确定性修复算子内并强制执行预设策略，防止恶意智能体劫持多智能体系统的重规划过程。
